description:
Read parent zaq-h2i.3 current coding-agent handoff and its mandatory reuse map first; it supersedes historical comments. Follow AGENTS.md and referenced workflow, tool, reuse, code-quality, service and testing policies; DESIGN.md/BO guide for UI. Planning only: wait for explicit implementation authorization. New existing-test behavior changes need approval. Keep per-issue steps/evidence here. Action reuse: extend existing authorized domain operations and components; no new Action/endpoint/tool.

After channel/SMTP/widget implementation, inspect whole final diff for drift against parent reuse map. Prove the same selected adapter declarations flow through existing Bridge/CommunicationBridge normalization into BO, FileSettings validation and TransportRequirements.resolve; provider branches, duplicate normalization, validation and requirement builders are unacceptable. Extend existing contract/unit/property/Engine/LiveView suites for all three bridges, exact MB/ceilings, blank/whitespace/false, unsupported SMTP, proposed-config updates, failed lookups/recovery, hidden tabs and atomic rollback. Run focused isolated tests and mix q under docs/WORKFLOW_AGENT.md; record actual evidence, not old logs. Update existing Channels/Engine owner docs and existing component Storybook stories; no parallel spec docs. Complete code review and present concrete screens for UX approval; do not author new feature browser journeys before that gate. This is integration validation/review, not numerical coverage/final precommit.

comments.text: Integration review found a new widget partial-draft loss: Map.merge at the form root replaces file_delivery when a single nested control validates. New owning-suite regression proves the size draft disappears after a policy-only event. Existing FileSettings.merge_form normalizes into stored values and cannot retain invalid raw drafts; existing FileDeliverySettings.form_params strips markers only. Add a focused private merge_draft_params/2 in WebWidgetLive for raw form orchestration, used by existing validate/save display paths; no new public API or domain rule. Also verify streamed-only errors select Advanced when file metadata creates shared tabs, retaining Main behavior without file metadata. New tests only; no existing assertions weakened.

Integrated regression passed 839 checks (9 properties, 830 tests), including full Jido/Email/Web/Bridge/API, FileSettings/resolver, persistence/authorized saves and all three BO consumers; /tmp/zaq-h2i-integrated.log. Review added adversarial widget partial-draft and streamed-only Advanced error tests: red reproduced both losses separately, fixes pass 52 widget checks (/tmp/zaq-h2i-widget-review-{red,red2,green}.log). Final integration mix q passed after owner docs and existing story updates (/tmp/zaq-h2i-integration-q.log). Existing-test diff audit shows only explicitly approved additive metadata maps and the approved SMTP help expectation; all other existing assertion lines retained. mix.exs/mix.lock unchanged; external repos untouched. Full existing npm test running (593 cases); no new feature E2E authored. Current form screenshots being captured for UX gate; no precommit/coverage/commit/push/publication.

title: [zaq-h2i.3.12] Validate shared capability contracts and BO integration
